description: Recovered-file review uses an 8 KiB complete-only optional text comparison sharing disk/overwrite equality. Decoding/comparison batches use cheap root/ticket/handle checks; full recovery snapshot guards remain before publication/application, including a post-comparison guard. Missing and empty disk versions remain distinct.
sharedImplementation: core RecoveryTextComparison/equal_text; frontend compare_review_disk/read_review_current/read_review_disk above unchanged Workspace local FSA and remote API adapters.
